projects.title: Matrimonial App UI/UX Design
projects.description:
I’m developing a fresh matrimonial platform that must feel intuitive to two distinct audiences at once—individuals searching for their own partner and parents or relatives guiding the process on their behalf. Every screen needs to project a modern, minimal aesthetic: clean grids, calm colour palette, generous white space, and typography that feels current without being trendy.

Here’s the ground I need you to cover end-to-end:

• Map the information architecture and user flows—from onboarding and dual-role dashboards (self versus family) through profile creation, browsing, matching, and messaging.  
• Translate those flows into low-fidelity wireframes, then into polished high-fidelity UI for common iOS and Android break-points.  
• Build a reusable design system (colour tokens, type scale, components, iconography) so my engineers can move quickly.  
• Package everything in an interactive Figma prototype I can demo to stakeholders, with neatly organised layers, auto-layout, and named components.  
• Provide final export-ready assets (SVG/PNG) alongside clear hand-off notes.

Acceptance criteria  
– Each primary journey is represented for both user archetypes (individual and family) and tested for clarity.  
– Visuals meet at least WCAG AA colour-contrast standards.  
– All files are tidy, documented, and developer-ready.

If this aligns with your skill set, let’s discuss timelines and iteration cycles so we can launch smoothly.

projects.title: Consumer-Focused Website Redesign
projects.description:
I want to turn www.mothergoosehealth.com from its current B2B feel into an inviting, consumer-facing destination where expectant and new mothers instantly understand our programs and feel confident buying or enrolling. Right now the product pages are written for insurers and clinicians; they need to speak directly to moms. At the same time the look and feel should soften—warmer colours, friendlier typography, more white space—so the site feels modern, reassuring, and personal rather than corporate.

Scope of work  
• Re-think the information architecture around the journey a mother takes when evaluating our service.  
• Rewrite or restructure product and service pages so benefits are crystal clear, jargon-free, and purchase paths are obvious.  
• Produce a fresh visual identity (colour palette, imagery, iconography) and apply it across responsive desktop and mobile layouts.  
• Deliver high-fidelity designs (Figma, Sketch, or similar) and, if you have front-end capability, pixel-perfect HTML/CSS ready for hand-off or implementation.

Acceptance criteria  
– Every primary page guides the visitor toward enrolment or purchase in no more than three clicks.  
– Design assets are provided in organised, editable source files.  
– All copy is written for a consumer reading level (Flesch score ≥ 60).  
– Final designs are WCAG 2.1 AA accessible.

When you reply, please share examples of past work that show you have transformed B2B or medical sites into consumer-friendly experiences; that portfolio piece will help me shortlist quickly. I look forward to collaborating on a site that truly speaks to the moms we serve.

projects.title: Modern EdTech Logo Design
projects.description:
I’m refreshing my education platform and need a sharp, modern, tech-focused logo that works equally well on the website and in the mobile app. The brand will be represented through a clean letter-based approach, and I’d like the final mark distilled down to our initials or a smart monogram.  

You’ll create both dark-mode and light-mode versions so the logo remains crisp against any background. Please supply scalable vector files (SVG, AI), web-ready PNGs in multiple resolutions, and the accompanying color and typography specifications so I can weave the look consistently across all screens.

Acceptance criteria  
• Monogram/initial logo that clearly communicates an innovative EdTech identity  
• Separate light and dark variants with identical geometry  
• Delivered in outlined, editable vector format plus transparent PNG exports  
• Simple color palette that meets WCAG AA contrast for accessibility  

If you have questions about the brand name, color preferences, or usage scenarios, let me know and I’ll respond quickly so you can focus on the creative work.
